strategy.positioning_statement: Quantitative technology engineer with direct financial-markets systems experience across derivatives, collateral, fixed income, OMS, suitability and audit-oriented workflows. Position as a hands-on principal-level individual contributor who can rapidly translate trading and risk-adjacent requirements into robust applications, APIs and quantitative-system components. For Quantum Capital Partners, lead with evidence of market-domain fluency and production engineering delivery; do not imply formal quantitative-risk model ownership unless separately evidenced.
leadership_themes: Principal-level technical ownership through architecture, engineering judgement and end-to-end delivery rather than unsubstantiated people-management claims.
Rapid conversion of ambiguous front-office, trading or risk-adjacent needs into usable prototypes, APIs and production-ready technology.
Financial-markets systems credibility spanning derivatives, collateral, fixed income and order-management contexts.
Control-conscious engineering, using suitability and audit-related experience to reinforce reliability, traceability and governance in quantitative technology.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim ownership, calibration, validation or regulatory approval of quantitative risk models, including VaR, expected shortfall, PFE, XVA, market risk, credit risk or liquidity-risk models, unless supported by additional evidence.
Do not describe the candidate as a formal risk manager, model-risk manager, chief risk officer, or regulatory reporting owner.

Do not claim people leadership, budget ownership, programme leadership or direct reports; the supplied job analysis contains no leadership mandate and the cited facts do not establish these responsibilities.
Do not claim low-latency trading-platform, execution-algorithm, pricing-engine or real-time market-data expertise unless independently evidenced.
Do not claim expertise in specific languages, cloud platforms, databases, DevOps tooling, asset classes or risk regulations when those details are absent from the supplied facts.
Do not state Singapore work authorization or permanent-employment availability without candidate confirmation.

Do not present the Alan Partners RAD Developer job analysis as evidence that Quantum Capital Partners requires a Principal Quantitative Risk Engineer profile; use it only as an adjacent benchmark for quantitative and trading-technology positioning.
